info.title: Topicary REST API
info.summary: Programmatic access to topics, components, maps, publication targets, and webhooks.
info.description:
The Topicary REST API lets you manage a single project's content
programmatically: create and edit topics and reusable components, organize
maps, inspect publication targets, and register webhooks.

## Base URL

```
https://topicary.com/api/v1
```

## Authentication

Every request must include an API key as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer tk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Generate keys in **Project Settings → API Keys**. A key is scoped to the
project it was created in and inherits that project's plan. The plaintext
key is shown only once at creation; Topicary stores only a SHA-256 hash.

## Response envelope

Authoring endpoints use `data` on success, `error` on failure,
and a `meta` block on list endpoints:

```
Success (one)    { "data": { ... } }
Success (list)   { "data": [ ... ], "meta": { "total", "offset", "limit" } }
Error (4xx/5xx)  { "error": "message" }
DELETE           204 No Content (empty body)
```

`GET /targets/{targetId}/pages` returns its published-page DTO directly:
`{ "generationId", "pages", "nextCursor", "site"? }`, with no `data` or
`meta` wrapper. Failures use `error` and an optional machine-readable `code`.

## Pagination

Authoring list endpoints accept `offset` (default `0`) and `limit` (default `50`,
maximum `100`) query parameters and report `meta.total` for the full count.
Published pages instead use an opaque, generation-bound `cursor` and
`nextCursor`; restart from the first page if the served generation changes.

## Rate limits

Authoring requests are limited to **1000 requests per minute per API
key**. Unauthenticated requests (bad or missing keys) are limited to 100
per minute per IP. Published pages have a separate **300 requests per minute
per validated API key** limit. Exceeding a limit returns `429 Too Many Requests`.

## Request bodies

Send `Content-Type: application/json`. JSON request bodies are capped at
**1 MB** by default; topic creation and updates allow **3 MiB**. Document content is TipTap/ProseMirror JSON — a `content_json`
object with `type: "doc"` and a `content` array.

get.description:
Returns the project's topics, newest first, with an exact matching count.
Requires `topics:read`, `topics:write`, or a legacy key. API access
requires the project's current Business plan.

200.description: A private, uncached paginated list of topic summaries.

post.description:
Requires `topics:write` or a legacy key and the project's current Business
plan. Atomically creates a draft topic, initial version, default workflow,
same-project reference indexes, mutation receipt, and webhook intent.
Topic JSON request bodies are capped at 3 MiB; canonical content is
independently capped at 2 MiB and metadata at 256 KiB in storage.
Reuse the same Idempotency-Key and exact body after an uncertain response
to recover the original result. A changed request with the same identity
returns 409. Without a caller identity, each request is a new operation.

201.description: The created topic or its exact saved receipt replay.

get.description:
Returns main content and its current document/metadata revisions, never
an editor's active branch. Requires topics:read, topics:write, or a legacy
key and the project's current Business plan. Does not expose CRDT state.

patch.description:
Requires topics:write or a legacy key and the current Business plan.
Writes MAIN content unless branch_id explicitly selects a branch of this
topic. Main body replacement atomically advances its document revision
and collaboration epoch, records version history, updates references,
marks translated content stale, and records the receipt/webhook intent.
It refuses accepted collaborative updates that are not yet materialized.
Branch bodies have independent revisions and reference indexes; a pure
branch write leaves main body, history, translations, and webhook intent
unchanged. A mixed branch/title patch also changes shared topic metadata
and marks translations stale for that title change.
Use the strong ETag from GET as If-Match to protect both revisions, or
supply expected_document_revision/expected_metadata_revision in the body.
For branch content, use that branch's document revision and the shared
topic metadata revision. Without explicit preconditions, the handler
reads a current basis and SQL still checks it atomically against races.
Exact retries retain their original basis; they do not become new edits.
Body limits are the same as topic creation.

200.description: The committed topic summary or its exact saved receipt replay.

delete.description:
Requires topics:write or a legacy key and the current Business plan.
Checks both main revisions, current workflow, and accepted collaborative
updates before atomically deleting the topic and dependent artifacts.
Referencing maps retain a deleted-topic marker and version history.
Exact retries return the original deletion receipt after the row is gone.
Supply Idempotency-Key to retain that identity across an uncertain response.

204.description: Deleted, or the exact saved deletion receipt replayed. Empty body.

200.description: A paginated list of component summaries.

patch.description: Supply at least one of `title` or `content_json`.

200.description: A paginated list of map summaries.

get.description: Returns the map plus its ordered `items` (the table of contents).

patch.description: Supply at least one of `title` or `description`.

delete.description:
Deleting a map also removes its publication targets and unpublishes any
sites served from them.

get.description: Returns every publication target across all of the project's maps.

200.description: A paginated list of target summaries.
The target, including its SEO, variable-override, and output configuration.

get.summary: Read pages from the currently served publication generation
get.description:
Returns pages from the target's immutable served generation, in published
order. Requires `published:read`, `targets:read`, `export:read`, or a
legacy API key, and the project's current Business API capability. The
target must belong to the key's project and have a served publication.
This is API-key access, not the separate reader-cookie endpoint.

The response is a direct PublishedPages object, without a data/meta
envelope. Pages contain captured page IDs, slugs, titles, Markdown/text,
canonical URLs and headings. The projection omits the separate topicId,
metadata, resolvedJson and collaboration-state fields.

Omit cursor (or pass an empty cursor) for the first page. Follow nextCursor
unchanged until it is null. Nonempty cursors are base64url-encoded
generation/offset objects, at most 512 characters, with a UUID generation
and a nonnegative safe-integer offset. A cursor for another served
generation returns 409 generation_changed; restart without the cursor.
This endpoint uses cursor instead of offset and reports no total count.
An offset beyond the captured page list returns an empty pages array and
null nextCursor.

`include=site` adds captured site/project display names and navigation on
that response. Other include values are ignored. Navigation is bounded
by a traversal-depth budget of 32, 1,000 entries and 64 KiB of JSON. If that
projection exceeds a budget, site.navigationState is unavailable and
site.navigation is empty; published pages are still returned.

Responses, including failures, are private, no-store. The separate rate
limit is 300 requests per minute per validated API key. A failed lookup
or unavailable generation is an error, not an empty successful page list.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding response; omit or pass empty to start pagination.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Exactly site includes captured site metadata; other values have no effect.

200.description: A page of the current served generation, with an optional site projection.

400.description: Invalid target UUID, limit outside 1–100, or malformed/oversized/unsafe cursor.

invalidTarget.summary: The target ID is not a UUID

invalidPagination.summary: The limit or cursor is invalid

401.description: Invalid/missing/revoked key or unavailable API plan (invalid_api_key), or expired key (api_key_expired).

invalidKey.summary: The key is missing, invalid, revoked or not eligible for API access

403.description: The key grants none of the accepted published-page scopes.

example.error: API key does not grant published page access

404.description: The target does not exist or belongs to a different project.

409.description: The target has no served publication (generation_unavailable), or pagination's served generation changed (generation_changed).

noServedGeneration.summary: The target has no served publication

generationChanged.summary: Restart pagination without the previous cursor

429.description: The published-page limit of 300 requests per minute per validated key was exceeded.

503.description: API-key validation (api_key_unavailable), target lookup, generation loading (generation_unavailable), or page projection is unavailable.

keyValidationUnavailable.summary: API key validation could not complete

lookupUnavailable.summary: The target lookup could not complete

generationUnavailable.summary: The served generation could not be loaded

pagesUnavailable.summary: The published-page request could not complete

post.description:
Registers an outbound webhook. The `url` must be a public HTTPS
endpoint. The response includes a `secret` (prefixed `whsec_`) used to
verify the `X-Topicary-Signature` HMAC header on each delivery — it is
returned only once, at creation.

201.description: The created webhook, including its signing secret.

get.description: Returns the webhook plus its 10 most recent delivery attempts.

ApiKeyAuth.description: A project-scoped API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer tk_...`.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

TopicIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
TopicIdempotencyKey.description:
A 1–255 character caller key. Identity is bound to the credential, method,
route and topic family. It takes precedence over body mutation_id.
Retry with the same request; changed input returns 409.

TopicIfMatch.name: If-Match
TopicIfMatch.description:
Strong revision pair, e.g. "c2-m3". Wildcards, weak ETags and lists are
refused. Explicit body revisions must agree with this pair. Protects
both stated revision families, even for a title-only patch.

PublishedPagesCacheControl.description: Published-page responses and errors direct HTTP caches not to store them.

TopicETag.description: Strong document/metadata revision pair for this main or branch destination.

TopicReplayed.description: Whether this response recovered an existing committed receipt.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed (invalid ID, missing field, or invalid JSON).

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, malformed, expired, or not permitted on this plan.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist in this project.

TooManyRequests.description: The rate limit (1000/min per key) was exceeded.

TopicForbidden.description: Insufficient topic scope, revoked authority, or a read-only/unknown workflow stage.

TopicConflict.description:
Revision conflict, changed input for an existing identity, or accepted
collaborative updates awaiting materialization. The code distinguishes
revision_conflict, idempotency_conflict and collaboration_pending.

TopicInvalidInput.description: Canonical document, metadata, or same-project reference validation failed; no mutation committed.

Unavailable.description: Authentication, database, or verified receipt is unavailable; do not infer an empty result or completed mutation.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query.

ContentJson.description:
A TipTap/ProseMirror document. Must have `type: "doc"` and a `content`
array of nodes. The node vocabulary mirrors the editor (paragraphs,
headings, lists, tables, callouts, code blocks, images, and Topicary's
custom nodes: componentRef, conditionalBlock, variableToken, topicLink).

title.description: The topic title (required, trimmed; must be non-empty).

mutation_id.description: Caller mutation UUID, used when Idempotency-Key is absent.

TopicUpdate.description: Supply at least one editable field.

mutation_id.description: Caller mutation UUID, used when Idempotency-Key is absent.

branch_id.description:
Destination of the content write. Omit it (the default) to write the
topic's main content. Supply a branch of this topic to write that
branch instead; requires `content_json` in the same request, and a
branch that does not exist or cannot be written returns `404`. The
branch a person has open in the editor never affects this endpoint.

topic_id.description: The topic at this position, or null for a label-only heading.

title_override.description: Display label used when topic_id is null, or to override the topic title.

output_format.description: The output channel for this target.

nextCursor.description: Opaque generation-bound cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.

id.description:
Copied captured page ID. Current map publication builders use
map-item occurrence IDs; legacy artifacts without an ID use
generationId:slug. This field is not restricted to a UUID.

contentMarkdown.description: Published resolved Markdown, with an HTML-stripped fallback for legacy artifacts.

contentText.description: Plain text from published resolved content, with an HTML-stripped fallback.

url.description: Canonical custom-domain or subdomain URL, otherwise the request origin plus /sites/targetId; the slug is percent-encoded.

project.description: Captured project display name, not its ID.

navigationState.description: Unavailable means navigation is an empty array rather than a partial projection.

WebhookEvent.description: A subscribable event type. Use `*` to subscribe to all events.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret (prefix `whsec_`). Returned only at creation.

url.description: A public HTTPS endpoint. Private/loopback addresses are rejected.

tags.name: Topics
tags.description: Authoring units. Content is stored as TipTap/ProseMirror JSON.

tags.name: Components
tags.description: Reusable content snippets referenced by topics.

tags.name: Maps
tags.description: Hierarchical tables of contents that order topics for publishing.

tags.name: Targets
tags.description: Publication targets (read-only). One map can publish to many targets.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Outbound event subscriptions delivered with an HMAC signature.
